avis.texte: As a dry skin girlie, this is THE product. It feels oily, but it absorbs in about 30 minutes and makes your skin feel really soft. Only use a little per use. Again, if you have dry, flakey skin (not dehydrated skin) this is perfect as a replacement for your regular cloggy sebum. Smells good too!

I have oily skin and was a little skeptical at first because it has oil in it, but was I wrong! It absorbs beautifully without it feeling sticky and greasy and makes your skin so soft. I've been using it for a month now, no break outs in sight and it actually is helping my skin produce less oil. I will be buying from this brand for all my other skincare needs. Do yourself a favor and try it.
